verdict.rationale: Viam documents the full teleoperation loop. Live camera feeds stream in real time to the browser (viam-docs-5). Bases can be driven with keyboard controls from the web UI or with a gamepad or joystick through the base remote control service (viam-docs-6, viam-docs-68). A Teleop interface supports monitoring dashboards (viam-docs-72). For real-world networks, it offers built-in NAT traversal with no VPN or port forwarding (viam-docs-4, viam-docs-42), plus WebRTC transport with sessions and automatic reconnect (viam-docs-70). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of control responsiveness and latency, and documented behavior of live video under low-bandwidth or high-latency links.
